summary: Straight-line state reset on an MPEG-audio lap/performance tracking object: copies the current frame/buffer-level value from field +0x249C into the tracking field +0x24E8, then zeroes the frame bit-position, stream bit-position, accumulated byte-position, and frame-count fields (+0x24A8, +0x24AC, +0x24B4, +0x24E4). Returns constant 0. Called during decoder open paths by CMpegBase_Open and CMpegFilePlayer_Open.

local_names.this[2343]: source field at +0x249C, current frame size / buffer level copied into the tracking field
local_names.this[2362]: tracking field at +0x24E8, receives the value of this[2343]
local_names.this[2347]: stream bit-position field at +0x24AC, reset to 0
local_names.this[2349]: accumulated byte-position field at +0x24B4, reset to 0

operations.description: Copy this[2343] (+0x249C) into this[2362] (+0x24E8): the tracking field takes the current frame/buffer-level value before the counters are cleared
Set this[2347] (+0x24AC) to 0: stream bit position reset
Set this[2346] (+0x24A8) to 0: bit position in current frame reset
Set this[2361] (+0x24E4) to 0: frame count reset
Set this[2349] (+0x24B4) to 0: accumulated byte position reset
Return constant 0; no guard gates any of the writes, so every field is always reset
Invoked by CMpegBase_Open (0052e090) during the decoder-open path
Invoked by CMpegFilePlayer_Open (0052e1d0) during the file-player open path
